title: spergularia lignosa
intro: Spergularia lignosa, commonly known as Wood-sorrel or Wood Sorrel, is a species of flowering plant in the family Caryophyllaceae. It is traditionally used for its health benefits, including treating urinary tract infections, fever, and coughs, as well as its ability to reduce inflammation and promote digestion. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its antiseptic, antibacterial, and anti-inflammatory properties, which help to soothe and heal various health issues. The bioactive constituents of Spergularia lignosa include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
